SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days, COUNT(*) AS total_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(delivered_ts) < julianday(shipped_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_days FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01'
